name: Pulicat Lake Fishermen's Fresh Seafood (cooked-to-order)
signature_dish: Fish fry and prawn curry from the day's catch
why_it_matters: Pulicat Lake — India's second-largest brackish lagoon — has very few standalone restaurants on its Andhra (Nellore-district) side, but the genuine local food experience is buying fresh fish, prawns and crab from the fishermen at the jetty and having it cooked to order on the spot. Visitors repeatedly describe arranging fish fry, prawn curry, crab curry and rasam this way. This is the authentic Pulicat meal.
insider_tip: Negotiate the catch and the cooking fee before they start. Best around the morning catch when fish is freshest; some boatmen combine a lagoon boat trip with a cooked seafood lunch on the islands. Carry cash and water — facilities are basic.
signature_address: Pulicat Lake fishing jetty, Nellore District, Andhra Pradesh

name: Sri Komala Vilas
signature_dish: Ghee roast dosa + South Indian breakfast
why_it_matters: A well-known pure-veg South Indian hotel in Sullurpeta — the AP-side gateway town ~20km from Pulicat Lake — repeatedly called the best breakfast in Sullurpeta and famous for its ghee roast dosa. With dining inside Pulicat itself genuinely sparse, Sullurpeta is where most lake visitors break for a proper veg meal before or after the lagoon and bird sanctuary.
insider_tip: Near the Police Station in Sullurpeta. Breakfast is the strong service — ghee roast dosa is the order; reviewers find the meals plate more ordinary. Gets crowded; come early.
signature_address: Near Police Station, Sullurpeta, Nellore District 524121

name: Sullurpeta Local Restaurants (gateway dining)
why_it_matters: Sullurpeta, the AP-side gateway ~20km from Pulicat Lake, is the larger hub where lake day-trippers find sit-down meals and biryani — Pulicat town itself has almost no proper restaurants on the Andhra side. The town has a wide spread of veg and non-veg hotels covering Andhra meals, biryani and South Indian tiffin, the practical meal stop on a Pulicat bird-sanctuary day.
insider_tip: Plan your main meal in Sullurpeta — going or returning — rather than expecting a restaurant at the lake. For seafood, the fishermen's cooked-catch at the jetty is the better Pulicat option; Sullurpeta is for reliable veg meals and biryani.
